description: This file contains feature detection functions for various web platform capabilities, including support for transferable streams, Apple Pay, OPFS, Cache Storage, IndexedDB, and CryptoKey clonability, as well as initialization and support query functions.

methods.name: isTransferableStreamsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the browser supports transferable streams by attempting to create and post a ReadableStream.

methods.name: isApplePaySupported
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if Apple Pay is supported by calling canMakePayments on ApplePaySession.

methods.name: isOPFSSupported
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if the Origin Private File System (OPFS) is supported by verifying getDirectory support.

methods.name: isCacheSupported
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if Cache Storage is supported by attempting to access a cache.

methods.name: isIndexedDBSupported
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if IndexedDB is supported by attempting to open a database.

methods.name: isCryptoKeyClonable
methods.description: Checks if generated CryptoKey can be cloned; if running in desktop app, assumes support.

methods.name: initializeFeatureChecks
methods.description: Initializes all feature support checks concurrently.

methods.name: isFeatureSupported
methods.description: Returns whether a specific feature is supported based on the FEATURE_CHECKS object.
